title: Confidence-gated hybrid retrieval for LLM root cause localization
main_contribution: Show when retrieval helps or hurts AC@k of an open-weight LLM diagnoser on several RCAEval systems, and gate retrieval by the diagnoser's calibrated confidence
difference_note: G3 part is partially-filled: P42 already reports ECE/coverage with GPT-4 on Train Ticket; difference is open-weight model, several systems, confidence used to decide retrieval

title: Retrieval-design ablation for LLM root cause localization (empirical study)
main_contribution: Measure the effect of none/BM25/dense/hybrid/rerank retrieval on AC@k across RCAEval systems with paired tests
difference_note: Pure empirical study; P50 did a similar ablation for text failure narratives in another domain

title: Calibrated and abstaining open-weight LLM for root cause localization
main_contribution: Make the reported accuracy trustworthy: ECE, selective accuracy vs coverage, abstention when evidence is insufficient, across 3 systems
difference_note: Not 'nobody did it': P42 calibrates a GPT-4 neurosymbolic fusion; difference is open-weight LLM, multi-system, selective prediction

title: LLM root cause localization under missing modalities and uninstrumented services
main_contribution: Quantify degradation when traces/logs/metrics are dropped or a service is a blind spot, and test a fallback
difference_note: Closest non-LLM work: P63 (anomaly detection with missing metrics), arXiv ARMOR

title: Small-model-first cascade for cost-aware root cause localization
main_contribution: Route only uncertain incidents from a cheap ranker to the LLM and report accuracy vs tokens/latency curves
difference_note: Cascade exists for log analysis (P67); difference is RCA task and cost curves instead of single operating points

title: Evidence-faithfulness evaluation of LLM root cause explanations
main_contribution: Define and validate a metric that checks cited evidence against telemetry and agrees with human judgement
difference_note: P45 has evidence correctness by construction, P30 human rating; arXiv JustDiag/OpsCortex overlap

title: Cross-system transfer protocol for LLM root cause localization
main_contribution: Tune on one RCAEval system, test on another, compare with in-system tuning
difference_note: Key closest paper UDA-RCL read at abstract level only; arXiv TraFaultDia overlaps
